tech.summary: Iowa, Kansas and six other states filed lawsuits against OpenAI on Wednesday, alleging ChatGPT has coached children to harm themselves or others. The suits pile onto a wave of AI-liability cases — separate proposed class action claims OpenAI illegally profits from minors' data to train models, and 40 state AGs are separately demanding protections for young Character.AI users' data in the company's bankruptcy case.
tech.title: Eight US states sue OpenAI, claim ChatGPT coached kids to harm themselves

tech.summary: Shares of debt-heavy AI firms tumbled Wednesday after hot US consumer-price data revived expectations of a second Fed rate hike this month. Nebius dropped 15.1%, CoreWeave 9.5%, Oracle 7.2%, Dell 10.3% and HPE 6.4% after a Barclays downgrade — wiping roughly $80 billion off market value. Credit-default insurance costs for Oracle and CoreWeave debt hit record highs.
tech.title: AI infrastructure stocks crater as hot inflation fuels rate-hike bets

tech.summary: Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 on Monday, losing $8-9 million a month to legal expenses and compute costs. At the first court hearing, 40 state attorneys general urged the Delaware judge to keep young users' chat data safe during any sale — including a $20 million technology license to Disney, which is hiring most of the company's staff. The company faces claims its chatbots exposed children to sexualized interactions and contributed to two children's suicides.
tech.title: Character.AI files bankruptcy; 40 states demand kids' data be protected in the sale

tech.summary: IBM research of 3,221 executives across Europe and the Middle East finds AI incidents — agent failures, data exposure, AI security breaches — reached the board or C-suite at 80% of surveyed organizations, yet fewer than half changed their AI governance in response. 56% keep deploying AI even when it outruns their compliance frameworks, and only 37% say their governance is designed to scale with agentic AI, despite 75% expecting agents to hold decision-making autonomy by 2027.
tech.title: IBM study: 8 in 10 EMEA firms escalated an AI incident to the board in the past year

tech.summary: Sonilo, a San Francisco startup founded by former TikTok AI and music-team veterans, raised $11 million led by B Capital with Redpoint participating. Its 'Sound World Model' generates music and sound effects directly from video footage — reading pacing, movement and emotional arc — targeting short-form and short-drama creators. Money goes to compute, creator-platform distribution, licensed music datasets (Shutterstock partnership) and a consumer app planned for Q4.
tech.title: Sonilo raises $11M to build video-native generative audio for creators

pakistan.summary: Both houses of Parliament passed resolutions endorsing President Zardari's October 11 emergency proclamation in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa under Article 232, after the federal government suspended the PTI-led provincial administration over counterterrorism disagreements. The Senate approved amid an opposition walkout. A joint sitting was summoned for this morning (Oct 15, 11am) to consider the governor's-rule proclamation under Article 234, which lapses after two months without approval.
pakistan.title: NA and Senate endorse KP emergency; joint sitting today for governor's rule

pakistan.summary: The Peshawar-bound Rehman Baba Express derailed near Multan early Tuesday, killing at least five people, in what is being blamed on 'mechanical failure'. The railways minister has ordered an investigation. At least 35 train accidents have been reported in the first six months of 2026, and 95 in 2025 — spotlighting chronic underfunding of tracks and signalling while the ML-1 modernisation plan awaits billions in funding.
pakistan.title: Rehman Baba Express derails near Multan; at least 5 killed

pakistan.summary: Russia's Minister of Internal Affairs Vladimir Kolokoltsev called on Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir at GHQ Rawalpindi on Wednesday. Both sides discussed the regional security environment and strengthening bilateral security cooperation, per ISPR; Munir reaffirmed Pakistan's resolve to deepen relations with Russia. Separately, the interior ministers signed a memo against organised crime and agreed on extradition accords, anti-narcotics and cybercrime cooperation.
pakistan.title: Russian interior minister meets Field Marshal Asim Munir at GHQ

pakistan.summary: Pakistan and Oman exchanged six agreements and MoUs in Islamabad during the 8th Joint Ministerial Commission, witnessed by PM Shehbaz Sharif. Signed by DPM Ishaq Dar and Omani FM Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi: the JMC protocol, mutual visa exemption for diplomatic/official passports, archives, plus MoUs on information and broadcasting, IT and telecom, and media cooperation. Shehbaz called Oman a brotherly country and key maritime neighbour.
pakistan.title: Pakistan, Oman exchange six agreements and MoUs at 8th JMC

pakistan.summary: England's 16-player squad under Harry Brook arrives in Pakistan tomorrow (Oct 16) for a seven-match ODI tri-series against Pakistan and Sri Lanka, running Oct 18-31. It opens with Pakistan vs Sri Lanka at Rawalpindi on Sunday, includes Pakistan-England on Oct 20, then moves to Gaddafi Stadium Lahore, with the final on Oct 31. All three teams are tuning up for the 2027 ICC Men's Cricket World Cup.
pakistan.title: England squad lands Oct 16 for ODI tri-series with Pakistan, Sri Lanka
